make up one’s mind: She couldn't make up her mind about which dress to buy for the party.
她拿不定主意该买哪条裙子去参加聚会。
give in: After arguing for hours, he finally gave in and agreed with our plan.
争论了几个小时后,他终于让步,同意了我们的计划。
as usual: As usual, Grandpa took his dog for a walk right after breakfast.
和往常一样,爷爷早饭后立刻带狗去散步。
at midnight: The train arrived at midnight, so we had to take a taxi home.
火车午夜才到,所以我们只好打车回家。
as if: He talked about the small town as if he had lived there for years.
他谈起那座小镇,好像他在那里住了很多年似的。
at an end: After three long days of meetings, the conference was finally at an end.
经过漫长三天的会议,大会终于结束了。
in ruins: The old castle has been in ruins for hundreds of years.
那座古老的城堡已成为废墟几百年了。
dig out: It took the rescuers two hours to dig out the trapped miners.
救援人员花了两个小时才把被困的矿工挖出来。
a (great) number of: A great number of students joined the club this term.
这学期有大量的学生加入了这个社团。
sincerely: I sincerely hope that you will recover quickly and come back to school.
我真诚地希望你早日康复,回到学校来。
cyclist: The cyclist wore a bright red jacket so that drivers could see him easily.
那位骑自行车的人穿着鲜红的夹克,好让司机们容易看到他。
Nelson Mandela: Nelson Mandela spent twenty-seven years in prison before becoming president of South Africa.
纳尔逊•曼德拉在狱中度过了二十七年,后来成为南非总统。
warm-hearted: Our new neighbor is a warm-hearted woman who always helps people in trouble.
我们的新邻居是个热心善良的女士,总是帮助有困难的人。
selflessly: For years she worked selflessly to raise money for children in poor areas.
多年来她无私地工作,为贫困地区的孩子们筹集资金。
devoted: He is devoted to his research and often stays in the lab until midnight.
他潜心于自己的研究,经常在实验室待到午夜。
William Tyndale: William Tyndale translated the Bible into English so ordinary people could read it.
威廉•廷代尔把《圣经》译成英语,让普通人也能读懂。
Bible: She reads a page of the Bible every morning before breakfast.
她每天早饭前读一页《圣经》。
Norman Bethune: Norman Bethune came to China and gave his life to saving wounded soldiers.
诺曼•白求恩来到中国,为救治伤员献出了生命。
Mohandas Gandhi: Mohandas Gandhi believed that people could fight injustice without using violence.
莫罕达斯•甘地相信人们可以不用暴力来对抗不公。
Elias: Elias was only a young man when he first met the great leader.
伊莱亚斯第一次见到那位伟大领袖时还很年轻。
passbook: Grandfather keeps his old passbook in a drawer with other important papers.
祖父把他的旧存折和其他重要文件一起放在抽屉里。
Johannesburg: They flew to Johannesburg last week to visit their uncle.
上周他们飞往约翰内斯堡去看望叔叔。
out of work: His father has been out of work since the factory closed last year.
自从工厂去年倒闭,他父亲就一直失业。
ANC: He joined the ANC when he was young and fought for equal rights.
他年轻时加入了非国大,为平等权利而奋斗。
Youth League: My brother joined the Youth League at school and takes part in its activities.
我哥哥在学校加入了青年团,并参加团里的活动。
as a matter of fact: As a matter of fact, I have never been to that city before.
事实上,我以前从未去过那座城市。
blow up: The soldiers blew up the bridge to stop the enemy from crossing.
士兵们炸毁了桥,阻止敌人过河。
turn to: When she has problems, she always turns to her elder sister for advice.
遇到问题时,她总是向姐姐求助。
lose heart: Don't lose heart; you can still pass the exam if you work hard.
别灰心,只要你努力,仍然可以通过考试。
Robben Island: Many political prisoners were kept on Robben Island during those hard years.
在那些艰难的岁月里,许多政治犯被关押在罗本岛。
come to power: The new government came to power promising to improve education and healthcare.
新政府上台时承诺改善教育和医疗。
Transkei: He grew up in a small village in the Transkei region of South Africa.
他在南非特兰斯凯地区的一个小村庄长大。
be sentenced to: He was sentenced to five years in prison for what he had done.
他因自己的所作所为被判处五年监禁。
anti-: The prefix anti- is often used in words like anti-war and anti-smoking.
前缀 anti- 常用于 anti-war(反战)、anti-smoking(反吸烟)之类的单词中。
anti-black: Under the old laws, anti-black rules separated people by the color of their skin.
在旧法律下,反黑人的法规按肤色把人们分隔开来。
Cape Town: Cape Town is famous for its beautiful mountains and long sandy beaches.
开普敦以美丽的山峦和绵长的沙滩闻名。
Nobel Peace Prize: In 1993 he shared the Nobel Peace Prize with the president of his country.
1993年,他与本国总统共同获得了诺贝尔和平奖。
Obon: During Obon, Japanese families light lamps to welcome the spirits of their ancestors.
盂兰盆节期间,日本人家家点灯,迎接祖先的亡灵。
in memory of: The school built a library in memory of its first headmaster.
学校建了一座图书馆,以纪念它的首任校长。
play a trick on: The children often play a trick on their teacher by hiding his chalk.
孩子们常常藏起老师的粉笔来捉弄他。
